entities.summary: Matthew Landry Jones is an American former professional football player who was a quarterback in the National Football League (NFL) and XFL. He played college football for the Oklahoma Sooners and was selected by the Pittsburgh Steelers in the fourth round of the 2013 NFL draft. Jones was also a member of the Jacksonville Jaguars, Oakland Raiders, and Dallas Renegades.
